home.title: HoopLog
home.emptyHint: Start a shooting session or a workout to see it here.
home.startError: Could not start the session. Please try again.

session.title: Shooting session
session.endConfirmBody: Your shots are kept. A session with no shots is discarded.
session.actionError: Could not save that. Please try again.

workout.title: Workout
workout.endConfirmBody: Your sets are kept. A workout with no sets is discarded.
workout.actionError: Could not save that. Please try again.
workout.emptyHint: Tap Add exercise, pick one, then log your sets.

picker.title: Choose exercise
picker.emptyHint: Try another search or create your own.
picker.createError: Could not save the exercise. Please try again.
picker.nameDuplicate: An exercise with that name already exists.
picker.deleteBody: It is removed from this list. Workouts you already logged keep their sets.
picker.deleteError: Could not delete the exercise. Please try again.

plans.title: Training plans
plans.emptyHint: Create a plan to schedule your training week.
plans.nameDuplicate: A plan with that name already exists.
plans.actionError: Could not save that. Please try again.
plans.deleteBody: The plan and its schedule are removed. Your logged workouts and shooting sessions are kept.
plans.weekSummary: {{done}} of {{total}} planned items done this week
plans.weekEmpty: Nothing scheduled yet. Add exercises or shooting to a day.
plans.optionalHint: Targets are guidance. Leave a field blank for no target.
plans.removeBody: Your logged sets and shots are kept.

progress.title: Progress
progress.emptyHint: Log a shooting session or a workout and your charts and personal bests will show up here.
progress.periodEmpty: Nothing logged in this period yet.
progress.fgEmpty: Shoot a session and your field goal % will show up here.
progress.sessionsEmpty: Shooting sessions and workouts you log will show up here.
progress.volumeEmpty: Log sets with a weight and your total will show up here. Bodyweight sets are not counted.
progress.bestSessionNone: Take at least {{count}} shots in one session to set a best.
progress.streakDetail: In a row, within one session
progress.liftsNone: Log a lift to see your best weight or reps here.

profile.nameTooLong: Keep your name to {{max}} characters or fewer.
profile.saveError: Could not save that. Please try again.

welcome.title: Welcome to HoopLog
welcome.intro: Log your shooting and workouts, follow a weekly plan and watch your progress grow.
welcome.privacy: No account needed. Everything you log stays on this phone.
welcome.nameHint: Optional. You can change it later in Settings.

settings.title: Settings
settings.nameHint: Shown on the home screen. Leave it blank to hide the greeting.
settings.accountRow: Sign in or manage your account
settings.accountHint: Optional. HoopLog works fully without one.
settings.dataRow: Back up, restore or delete your data
settings.dataBody: Everything you log is saved on this phone. No account is needed.

account.title: Account
account.intro: An account is optional. HoopLog works fully without one.
account.backupNote: Signing in does not back up your data yet. Your workouts, shooting and plans still live only on this phone. To keep a copy, export a backup from Settings, under Your data.
account.notConfiguredBody: This build of the app is not connected to an account service. Everything else works as usual.
account.goToSignIn: Already have an account? Sign in
account.checkEmailBody: If {{email}} can be used for a new account, a confirmation link is on its way. Open it, then come back and sign in.
account.deleteBody: This removes your account and anything stored with it online. Your workouts, shooting and plans on this phone are not deleted.

error.invalidCredentials: That email and password do not match.
error.emailNotConfirmed: Confirm your email first: open the link we sent you, then sign in.
error.cannotCreate: Could not create that account. If you already have one, try signing in.
error.emailRateLimit: Too many emails were sent just now. Please wait a while and try again.
error.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
error.signUpDisabled: New accounts are not open right now.
error.sessionExpired: Your sign-in has expired. Sign in again, then retry.
error.network: Could not reach the server. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.notConfigured: Accounts are not set up in this build.
error.notAvailable: This is not available yet. Please try again later.
error.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

data.title: Your data
data.intro: Everything you log is saved on this phone. A backup is a file you can keep somewhere safe, or use to move to a new phone.
data.nothingSaved: Nothing saved yet. Log a workout or a shooting session and it will show up here.
data.backupBody: Save a copy of everything above as a file. Keep it in your files or cloud drive, or send it to yourself. Anyone who gets the file can read it, so keep it somewhere private.
data.exported: Backup created. If you closed the share screen without saving it, export again.
data.restoreBody: Choose a backup file made by HoopLog. It replaces what is on this phone now.
data.restoreConfirmBody:
This backup holds {{backup}}.

Restoring replaces what is on this phone now ({{current}}). Export first if you want to keep it.
data.restoreConfirmBodyEmptyPhone:
This backup holds {{backup}}.

Restoring puts it on this phone.
data.deleteBody: Remove everything you logged from this phone. This cannot be undone. An account, if you have one, is not affected.
data.deleteConfirmBody: Every workout, shooting session, plan, custom exercise and your name will be removed from this phone. This cannot be undone. Export a backup first if you might want it back.

error.notBackup: That file is not a HoopLog backup.
error.newerVersion: That backup was made by a newer version of HoopLog. Update the app, then try again.
error.damaged: That backup file is damaged or incomplete, so nothing was changed.
error.tooLarge: That file is too large to be a HoopLog backup.
error.unreadable: Could not open that file. Pick it again, or choose a different one.
error.shareUnavailable: This phone cannot share files from the app.
error.exportFailed: Could not create the backup. Nothing was changed. Please try again.
error.restoreFailed: Could not restore that backup. Your data on this phone was not changed.
error.deleteFailed: Could not delete your data. Nothing was changed. Please try again.
